content.short: Komainu is a regulated institutional custodian, with support for HYPE custody and staking.
content.description: Komainu provides regulated custody for institutions, built to bank-grade standards and aimed at funds and corporates that need a licensed counterparty holding their assets. It announced custody and staking support for Hyperliquid's HYPE token, and Hyperliquid's builder documentation lists it among qualified custodians. Staking support matters here because custody alone would otherwise force institutions to choose between security and yield.
content.meta: Komainu is a regulated institutional custodian supporting HYPE custody and staking on Hyperliquid.
